children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationCallback
children.description: Container describes the Callbackfunction to call on a Routing Activation Request for Authentication. If this container is configured but the DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationFunc parameter is not present, the DoIP module will use an RPort of ServiceInterface <RoutingActivation>_RoutingActivation with the name "CB<RoutingActivation>RoutingActivation". <RoutingActivation> is the ShortName of the DoIPRoutingActiviation container.

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationFunc
children.description: Direct C Callback function to trigger the authentication function for routing activation. If the DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationFunc parameter is present, the DoIP module will not use an RPort of ServiceInterface <RoutingActivation>_RoutingActivation but call the configured function.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationReqLength
children.description: Describes the amount of bytes used to handle to the authentication function on routing activation. If 0 is configured as length the parameter AuthenticationReqData will not be handled to the API.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationResLength
children.description: Describes the amount of bytes used to read by the authentication function on routing activation. If 0 is configured as length the parameter AuthenticationResData will not be fetched via the API.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationCallback
children.description: Container describes the Callbackfunction to call on a Routing Activation Request for Confirmation. If this container is configured but the DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationFunc parameter is not present the DoIP module will use an RPort of ServiceInterface <RoutingActivation>_RoutingActivation with the name "CB<RoutingActivation>RoutingActivation". <RoutingActivation> is the ShortName of the DoIPRoutingActiviation container.

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationFunc
children.description: Direct C Callback function to trigger the confirmation function for routing activation. If the DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationFunc parameter is present the DoIP module will not use an RPort of ServiceInterface <RoutingActivation>_RoutingActivation but call the configured function.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationReqLength

children.name: DoIPRoutingActivationConfirmationResLength

children.name: DoIPDhcpOptionVinUse
children.description: If DoIPDhcpOptionVinUse is set to true the DoIP module will add the VIN to the Dhcp host name if no valid Dhcp host name is already set.

children.name: DoIPEntityStatusMaxByteFieldUse

children.name: DoIPGIDInvalidityPattern
children.description: Specifies the Byte pattern that is used for response messages if no valid GID could be retrieved.

children.name: DoIPGeneralInactivityTime
children.description: Timeout in [s] for maximum inactivity of a TCP socket connection before the DoIP module will close the according socket connection. Represents parameter T_TCP_General_Inactivity of ISO 13400-2:2012

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPHeaderFileInclusion
children.description: Name of the header file(s) to be included by the DoIP module containing the used C-callback declarations.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPHostNameSizeMax
children.description: Maximum Size of the DHCP HostName in ASCII. This parameter is necessary to reserve the correct amount of bytes for working with the DHCP HostName option. Minimum range is 5 because Dhcp Host Name should be at least "DoIP-" on any configuration.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPInitialInactivityTime
children.description: Timeout in [s] used for initial inactivity of a connected TCP socket connection directly after socket connection. Represents parameter T_TCP_Initial_Inactivity of ISO 13400-2:2012

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPInitialVehicleAnnouncementTime
children.description: Time to wait in [s] for sending first vehicle anouncement message after IP address assignment. Represents parameter A_DoIP_Announce_Wait of ISO 13400-2:2012

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: Determines the frequency at which the DoIP_MainFunction() is called in [s].

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPMaxRequestBytes
children.description: Specifies the maximum allowed bytes of a DoIP message request without the DoIP header.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPMaxTesterConnections
children.description: Maximum ammount of tester connections that shall be maintained at one time before alive check is performed.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPMaxUDPRequestPerMessage
children.description: This parameter captures the maximum amont of UDP Requests necessary to handle paralel within a single UDP connection.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPNodeType
children.description: Describes the Type of the DoIP node.

children.name: DoIPUseEIDasGID
children.description: Specifies if the DoIP entity shall use its EID if it is the Master for vehicle identification gid on the vehicle identification/vehicle announcement.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPUseMacAddressForIdentification
children.description: Provided the information if a configured EID at vehicle identification response/vehicle announment is used or the MAC address.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE: Use MAC Address instead of EID for Vehicle identification/announcement. FALSE: Use configured EID for vehicle identification/announcement. Dependencies: DoIPEID
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPUseVehicleIdentificationSyncStatus
children.description: Defines if the optional VIN/GID synchronization status is used additionally in the vehicle identification/announcement.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPVehicleAnnouncementInterval
children.description: Time to wait in [s] for sending subsequent vehicle anouncement messages. Represents parameter A_DoIP_Announce_Interval of ISO 13400-2:2012

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPVehicleAnnouncementRepetition
children.description: Amount of repetitions of the vehicle announcement message on IP address assignment. Represents parameter A_DoIP_Annunce_Num of ISO 13400-2:2012

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPVersionInfoApi
children.description: Activates the DoIP_GetVersionInfo() API.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE: Enables the DoIP_GetVersionInfo() API. FALSE: DoIP_GetVersionInfo() API is not included.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPVinGidMaster
children.description: Specifies if the DoIP entity is the Vehicle identification Master for the GID (Group ID).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPVinInvalidityPattern
children.description: Specifies the Byte pattern that is used for response messages if no valid VIN could be retrieved.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPGetGidCallback
children.description: This container describes the usage of a callback function to get the GID. (If this container is not present no callback function shall be used by DoIP module to retrive the GID.)

children.name: DoIPGetGidDirect
children.description: If the DoIPGetGidDirect parameter exist the DoIP module shall call the configured callback function (<User>_DoIPGetGID) direct. (It is not needed to specify a service port to the DoIP service component.)

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If the DoIPGetGidDirect parameter does NOT exist the DoIP module shall use a RPort with a CallbackGetGID type of client-server port interface to retrive the GID.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPPowerModeCallback
children.description: This container describes the usage of a callback function to retrieve the current power mode. This container shall always be present.

children.name: DoIPPowerModeDirect
children.description: If the DoIPPowerModeDirect parameter exist the DoIP module shall call the configured callback function (<User>_DoIPGetPowerModeCallback) direct. (It is not needed to specify a service port to the DoIP service component.)

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If the DoIPPowerModeDirect parameter does NOT present the DoIP module shall use a RPort with a CallbackGetPowerMode type of client-server port interface to retrive the current power mode.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DoIPTriggerGidSyncCallback
children.description: This container describes the usage of a callback function to trigger the GID synchronization. (If this container does not exist no callback function shall be used by DoIP module to trigger the GID synchronization.)

children.name: DoIPTriggerGidSyncDirect
children.description: If the DoIPTriggerGidSyncDirect parameter exist the DoIP module shall call the configured callback function (<User>_DoIPTriggerGidSyncCallback) direct. (It is not needed to specify a service port to the DoIP service component.)

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If the DoIPTriggerGidSyncDirect parameter does NOT present the DoIP module shall use a RPort with a CallbackTriggerGIDSynchnonization type of client-server port interface to trigger the GID synchronization.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
